full_judgment: 2. The petitioner's case in short, is that the opposite party Nos.I-25 as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.26 of 1991 for partition in the Court of Joint District Judge, 10 Court, Chandpur impleading the petitioners and opposite parties No.26-71 as defendants contending inter alia that the suit land belonged to Monir Uddin, Sonar Uddin and Muluk Jan who died leaving 4 sons namely Sadar Ali, Kofil, Sekandar and Fazar Ali. The Plaintiff Nos.l-1 I are heirs of the said Fazar Ali, plaintiff Nos.12- 16 are heirs of the Kofil Uddin, Plaintiff Nos.17-22 are heirs of the Safar Ali and plaintiff Nos.23-25 are heirs of Sekandar Ali. Muluk Jan died leaving her brother Gonortiddin. Said Gonoruddin died leaving defendant Nos.1-2 who transferred some of their shares to defendant Nos.3-4. The plaintiffs share in the suit land is 3/4 and rest are belongs to defendants. S.A. Khatian prepared wrongly. The plaintiffs claimed their sham but the defendants refused to their claim and hence the present suit.
